value_space: normalized PipeFormer forecast variables; replace proxy limits with real station and segment limits

category_details.pressure: Node pressure lower and upper bounds, key-node pressure margin, continuous out-of-limit duration, and recovery time.
category_details.flow: Segment flow change, maximum transmission capacity, boundary flow change rate, abnormal-flow segments, and supply-demand balance.
category_details.linepack: Linepack decline magnitude, recovery capability and time, short-term peak-shaving reserve, change rate, and warning status.
category_details.compressor: Compressor load, compression ratio, rotational speed, power, operating envelope, and regulation margin.
category_details.equipment_regulation: Valve opening, pressure-regulating equipment range, and allowable boundary-control adjustment magnitude.
category_details.abnormality_warning: Abnormal pressure drops, sudden flow changes, potential leaks, and equipment anomalies.
category_details.dispatch_priority: Pressure safety and supply assurance; compressor and equipment protection; linepack margin; flow stability; then energy and cost.
